qualifier: paracellular magnesium transport and tight junctions
name: Sodium, potassium and paracellular magnesium transport
rationale: All members concern Na+/K+/Mg2+ movement and homeostasis across epithelia; the tight-junction paracellular route and magnesium transport distinguish it from the chloride-cotransporter and P-type ATPase neighbours.

core: Lymphocyte chemotaxis and homing to lymphoid organs
name: Lymphocyte chemotaxis and lymphoid-organ homing via Cdc42/PLC signaling
rationale: Members describe B, T and dendritic cell chemotaxis and homing into lymphoid organs; T/B homing separates it from dendritic-cell chemokine neighbours and the Cdc42/PLC-PKC signaling members separate it from the lymphoid-tissue development neighbour.

name: Quiescence entry and exit in retinoic acid-induced differentiation
rationale: Members regulate G1-G0/G0-G1 transitions and differentiation-linked cell cycle exit with retinoic acid signaling, unlike the thyroid/nuclear receptor, TGF-beta/PAX3 and TP53 arrest neighbours.

name: Autophagosome assembly and depolarisation-induced mitophagy
rationale: Members cover phagophore cargo recruitment, autophagosome assembly control and PINK1-Parkin/receptor mitophagy; depolarisation-triggered mitophagy separates it from the xenophagy neighbour, and autophagosome assembly separates it from mitochondrial fission/fusion neighbours.

core: Antimicrobial killing of bacteria and fungi
name: Antibacterial and antifungal killing with peptidoglycan metabolism
rationale: Members describe cytolysis and killing of microbes, antifungal and Gram-positive defense and metal sequestration; peptidoglycan metabolism and peptide modification are what all confusables lack.

name: Plasma lipoprotein remodeling and clearance with lipolysis inhibition
rationale: Members cover remodeling and clearance of chylomicron, VLDL, LDL and HDL particles and lipase assembly; lacking intestinal assembly/ABC efflux and carrying negative regulation of triglyceride catabolism and VLDL remodeling separates it from neighbours.

name: CSF1 signaling in macrophage proliferation and osteoclastogenesis
rationale: Members describe M-CSF/CSF1R and related interleukin signaling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion and osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, unlike DAP12-centred or monocyte/dendritic cell differentiation neighbours.

qualifier: nucleoside phosphates, phosphocreatine, NAD(P) and mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport
name: Nucleotide phosphate, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) energy carrier metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert and transport high-energy phosphate and pyridine nucleotide carriers; neighbours each lack one arm (nucleotide phosphorylation, NAD/nicotinate, or creatine and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange).

name: L-amino acid metabolism centred on proline
rationale: Members are generic alpha/L-amino acid metabolic terms plus proline biosynthesis and catabolism; proline and glutamine-family metabolism distinguish it from glycine/serine and organic-acid neighbours.

core: HDL biogenesis via ABCA1 lipid efflux
name: ABCA1-mediated HDL biogenesis and lipoprotein remodeling
rationale: Members describe ABCA1/apoA-I phospholipid and cholesterol efflux forming HDL; HDL and LDL remodeling distinguish it from ABCB/ABCG transporter and LXR/foam-cell neighbours.

qualifier: motor learning and cerebellar layer formation
name: Locomotor control, motor learning and cerebellar cortex formation
rationale: Members concern locomotion, voluntary movement, reflexes and proprioception alongside cerebellar and striatal development; motor learning and cerebellar layering separate it from vocal/sensory behavior and cerebellar granule precursor neighbours.

core: Intracellular neutral lipid storage and mobilization
qualifier: lipid droplets, glycerolipid synthesis and lipolysis
name: Intracellular triglyceride storage, lipid droplet turnover and lipolysis
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis, lipid droplet formation and breakdown, lipolysis, lipophagy and fatty acid handling in adipocytes, unlike plasma lipoprotein or adipose development neighbours.

qualifier: Golgi export and vesicular cholesterol transport
name: Endosomal recycling and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane transport
rationale: Members describe endocytosis, endosome organization and recycling of receptors and proteins back to the cell surface plus Golgi-to-surface traffic, unlike retrograde endosome-to-Golgi, tubulation or constitutive secretion neighbours.

qualifier: oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants and ERK feedback inactivation
name: RAF-MEK-ERK signaling by oncogenic mutants and feedback inactivation
rationale: Members cover RAF and MAP2K/MAPK activation, oncogenic BRAF/RAF1/RAS/MAP2K variant signaling and ERK dephosphorylation feedback, unlike SOS/RIT or RAS-GAP neighbours.

core: Antimicrobial killing of bacteria and fungi
qualifier: mucosal innate defense and bacterial agglutination
name: Mucosal antimicrobial killing with bacterial agglutination
rationale: Members describe microbial cytolysis, antifungal and Gram-positive defense and metal sequestration; bacterial agglutination and mucosal innate immunity separate it from the peptidoglycan and respiratory-burst neighbours.

core: Vitamin K and vitamin C metabolism
name: Vitamin K-dependent carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation plus ascorbate metabolism, transport and response; ascorbate separates it from vitamin D/E/quinone neighbours and vitamin K carboxylation from the oxygen-transport neighbour.

qualifier: AXIN turnover in the destruction complex
name: Canonical Wnt signaling via AXIN destruction complex stability
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signaling controlled by AXIN and APC in the destruction complex; AXIN degradation and stabilization distinguish it from DVL/FZD-receptor and target-repression neighbours.

core: IKK recruitment and canonical NF-kappaB activation
name: TNFR1 and TLR-driven IKK recruitment and NF-kappaB activation
rationale: Members describe IKK recruitment via RIP1, IRAK1 and TRAF6 leading to NF-kappaB activation; TNFR1 signaling and linear ubiquitination separate it from TAK1/JNK, non-canonical NIK and negative-regulation neighbours.

core: Pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion and processing
name: Beta-cell insulin secretion via incretins and KATP channels
rationale: Members cover nutrient, incretin, neurotransmitter and fatty-acid regulation of insulin secretion, KATP channels and insulin processing, unlike insulin-action and GLUT4 translocation neighbours.

name: Myogenesis restraint and disuse skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: Members describe negative control of myoblast and muscle development, satellite cell maintenance and atrophy from inactivity, unlike pro-myogenic, hypertrophy and contraction neighbours.

qualifier: coupled to DNA replication and unwinding
name: Replication-coupled cohesin loading and sister chromatid cohesion
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, cohesion establishment and chromatin looping together with replication, unwinding and break-induced replication; cohesin separates it from replication-initiation and repair neighbours and replication from the cohesion-resolution neighbour.

core: Cranial and peripheral neuron axon guidance
name: Cranial and peripheral nerve axon guidance with hindbrain maturation
rationale: Members describe axon guidance and development of cranial, sympathetic and sensory ganglia and nerves; hindbrain/pons maturation separates it from commissural/olfactory neighbours and peripheral axon growth from the brainstem neighbour.

name: Centrosome, spindle microtubule and cytokinesis organization
rationale: Members cover centrosome and centriole control, spindle microtubule dynamics, kinase regulation of mitosis and cytokinesis; spindle and centrosome mechanics separate it from cilium-motility neighbours and centriole/microtubule dynamics from the chromosome-condensation neighbour.

core: Germinal center B cell maturation to plasma cells
name: Germinal center plasma cell differentiation and class switching
rationale: Members describe B cell, Tfh and plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin programs of germinal centers; isotype switching to IgA and IgG is the member set no confusable has.

qualifier: thymocyte development and shared T/B lymphocyte programs
name: T and B lymphocyte activation and thymocyte differentiation
rationale: Members describe TCR/ITK-PKC activation, second-messenger signaling and thymocyte and T cell subset differentiation with lymphocyte-wide modules; thymocyte development separates it from proximal TCR/CD28 neighbours and T/B-shared modules from the positive-selection neighbour.
